headline: "Uprising" of unions over the Salary Law. Bolojan asked to explain in what capacity he negotiates a law affecting a million employees
summary: Five union confederations demand withdrawal of the new Salary Law, which would affect a million public sector employees. Unions have questioned Prime Minister Bolojan's role in negotiating it.
why: Public sector wage law sets pay for a large share of the workforce and shapes government spending, which is relevant to Romania's fiscal position.

original_headline: „Răscoala” sindicatelor pe Legea salarizării. Bolojan, chemat să explice în ce calitate negociază o lege care afectează un milion de angajați
